structure.layout: single-screen centered splash with animated full-bleed canvas background, particle-text wordmark, rotating tagline, 4-digit code entry and icon footer nav; a centered Appearance modal dialog covers it with the page blurred behind

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack (renders as DejaVu Sans/system sans) everywhere: bold wide-tracked tagline, bold dialog title, bold theme names, small letter-spaced captions
aesthetics.typeScale: Huge particle wordmark (canvas), 48px/700 tagline, 24px/700 dialog title, 18px/700 option titles, 12-15px captions/descriptions; strong size contrast, letter-spaced bold headings

notes: Full-bleed animated fluid/smoke shader canvas background tinted by the active theme (blue in Midnight Drift, fiery orange in Solar Ember); 'ZestSend' wordmark rendered as dithered particle text on a canvas; tagline verb rotates ('write together', 'share screen', 'chat in real time') with matching glyph icon; 'end-to-end encryption' in mint green with lock. Appearance modal is a translucent dark glass panel (16px radius, 1px hairline border) with page blurred behind; theme rows are full-width with witty one-line descriptions and a flush right 3-block color swatch (bg/mid/accent), selected row gets 2px accent left rule, tinted bg, accent title and check. Selecting a theme instantly re-themes the whole UI including the background shader. Rows are square-edged inside the rounded dialog. Footer is three line icons (globe, gear, info) and a GitHub credit.
